name: The Role Of The Older Woman
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of the older woman as a teacher and example of holiness, emphasizing behavior that avoids false accusations and drunkenness while promoting sound doctrine, as seen in Titus 2:3. The wisdom and character of women are foundational for building and maintaining godly households, with Proverbs underscoring the value of a virtuous woman and contrasting her with contentious behavior. The partnership and mentorship exemplified by Priscilla in Acts 18:26 further illustrate the older woman's responsibility to guide others in understanding God's way more perfectly.
